protocol_history.clarification_scope: Require residual steering to be able to settle to zero before the clear-straight throttle multiplier is enabled.
protocol_history.clarification_timing: Post-registration and committed with the implementation; it is not an independently preregistered acceptance change.

video_diagnostic.interpretation: The videos establish slow completed laps but contain no comparable action/speed trace, so the code-level 0.08 throttle envelope is only a candidate mechanism.

synthetic_result.residual_steering_transition: gas remains exact to control until the current straight action can settle steering to zero

limitations: No paired environment execution was allowed, so a lap-time reduction on Tracks 1 or 3 has not been measured.
Only acceleration toward the unchanged target is altered; long straights already at target will not become faster.
The temporary package and timing checks used Windows Python 3.11.15, Torch 2.1.0+cpu and NumPy 1.26.0 rather than the official Linux runtime.
Post-registration acceptance clarifications were committed with implementation and therefore are not independently preregistered evidence.
This result is a bounded implementation diagnostic, not evidence of performance improvement, generalization, submission readiness, or SOTA.
